versions.content: Reference pointer to Post - build time configurable data If the BSW Module operates on post - build configuration data , then it shall use a reference (pointer) to an external configuration instance. This reference shall be provided via the BSW module’s initialization function (i.e., <Mip>_Init() ) via a const - qual ified function parameter.
